en.headline: State funeral for former chief executive Tung Chee-hwa set for 20 September
en.dek: A source confirmed the date on Saturday; state leaders and central government officials are expected to join the funeral committee.
body: The state funeral for Hong Kong’s first chief executive, the late Tung Chee-hwa, has been scheduled for 20 September, a source confirmed on Saturday.

Details of the arrangements are still being finalised. State leaders and central government officials are expected to join the funeral committee, following the practice of earlier state funerals held in Hong Kong.

Tung died on 8 September at the age of 89. Since the 1997 handover only two other prominent local figures—Ann Tse-kai in 2000 and Henry Fok Ying-tung in 2006—have been granted state funerals. Both, like Tung, held the rank of vice-chairman of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference. The government’s Administration Wing said earlier it would announce arrangements in due course.

zh.headline: 前特首董建華國葬定於9月20日舉行
zh.dek: 消息周六確認國葬日期，國家領導人和中央政府官員預期加入治喪委員會。
body: 香港首任行政長官董建華的國葬已定於9月20日舉行，消息人士周六確認。
相關安排仍在敲定。按照過往本港國葬先例，國家領導人和中央政府官員預期會加入治喪委員會。
董建華於9月8日逝世，享年89歲。回歸以來，本港僅有兩位知名人士獲頒國葬，分別是2000年的安子介和2006年的霍英東，兩人與董建華一樣曾任全國政協副主席。政府行政署早前表示會適時公布安排。
